audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Graves Levels 1 and 2 and hedged Level 6 through two items, while the page's own whys[0] says Ryze owns Level 1 and whys[6] says Ryze wins at two items.
audit.why: Packet chart and the audited Graves-side mirror agree: Ryze / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill / Ryze.
audit.corrected: Chart set to that, ratings adjusted, proposed as matched pairs across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored as even and phases[4].why sold Realm Warp as a duel upgrade.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a delayed group portal, not an escape — Graves still dashes the root on demand, so 6 is his. First item is even and two items is Ryze's.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Graves with the why rewritten; two-item stage flipped to Ryze.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is described as blinding Ryze's Q in three places, and the level-1 plan says to walk to melee range to auto-E.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Smoke Screen a sight-range cut and a brief slow — no blind, and it could not blind an ability anyway. Spell Flux is a 615-range cast, so no melee approach is needed. Rune Prison only roots if Flux is already on the target. End of the Line detonates on terrain, and with no dash on Ryze that is a retreat-cutter Flash must answer.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen restated as sight-cut plus slow, Spell Flux's 615 range used instead of a melee walk-up, Quickdraw's 16s rank-1 cooldown named, and the terrain retreat-cut added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw is the tracked cooldown but its number never appears, and 'the fifteen-second invitation' is a guess.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12 and its cooldown is reduced by landing basic attacks — so the count is not fixed while he is auto-ing.
audit.corrected: 16s at rank 1, with the auto-attack refund stated.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Pop Smoke Screen' — false positive on the name itself; the real error in that line was the blind, which is fixed.

edits.before: Q poke only — farm, respect everything, and bank Manaflow stacks. You're buying time, not fighting.
edits.after: No Quickdraw yet — step up, land Spell Flux at 615, and bank a free Manaflow stack.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Realm Warp is a group portal, not an escape; Quickdraw still dashes your root on demand.

edits.before: Dash + armor stacks — burst him after the charges are spent. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and refunds on autos — count it, and go only once it is truly spent.

edits.before: Track Graves’s Quickdraw: Dash + armor stacks — burst him after the charges are spent. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Quickdraw (16s at rank 1): burst him once it is spent. End of the Line detonates on terrain and can cut your retreat.

edits.before: Graves has only Q at level 1 and cannot dash yet — walk up to auto-E for a Manaflow stack while he has no escape.
edits.after: Graves has only Q at level 1 and cannot dash yet — Spell Flux reaches 615, so poke and bank a Manaflow stack for free.

edits.before: Ryze owns level 1 here — Graves has only Q at this stage and Ryze can walk up to auto-E and bank a Manaflow stack before Graves can dash away.
edits.after: Ryze owns level 1 here — Graves has only Q and no Quickdraw yet, so Spell Flux at 615 range banks a free Manaflow stack and chip damage.

edits.before: Graves's Quickdraw dash and Smoke Screen blind deny your Flux-chain pattern — he can dash through your W root, blind your follow-up Q, and reset to range before you re-engage.
edits.after: Graves's Quickdraw dash and Smoke Screen deny your Flux chain — he dashes through your W cast, then the smoke cuts your sight and slows you while he resets to range.

edits.before: Pop Smoke Screen under your feet to blind your Q follow-up and force you off the Flux rotation
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen on you to cut your sight and slow you, forcing you off the Flux rotation

edits.before: At level 1 Graves has only Q and you can actually walk up to melee range to auto-E and bank a Manaflow Band stack — he cannot dash away yet and his burst is lowest here, so grab that first. Level 2 is the inflection: the moment he picks up Quickdraw your W root becomes unreliable because he can dash straight through the cast animation, so stop walking up without a confirmed dash-burned read. By level 3 your full loop is technically online but Graves's Smoke Screen covers your feet exactly when you land W, blinding the empowered Q that was supposed to finish him — trade only when both his E dash and his W smoke are on cooldown, and accept that those windows are short.
edits.after: At level 1 Graves has only Q and Spell Flux reaches 615, so you can poke and bank a Manaflow Band stack without ever entering his optimal spread — he cannot dash away yet and his burst is lowest here. Level 2 is the inflection: the moment he picks up Quickdraw (16s at rank 1, refunded by his autos) your W root becomes unreliable because he dashes straight through the cast, so stop stepping up without a confirmed dash-burned read. By level 3 your loop is online but Smoke Screen (26s at rank 1) cuts your sight and slows you exactly when you land W — trade only when both his dash and his smoke are down, and accept those windows are short.

notes: The blind was the serious error: Smoke Screen cuts sight range and slows, it does not blind, and the page built its whole level-3 plan around a mechanic that does not exist. Also removed the 'walk up to melee range' instruction — Spell Flux is a 615-range cast. Level chart aligned to the packet and the audited Graves-side mirror.
